parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set system login user client001 class su.template: set system login user [parameter1] class [parameter2] authentication plain-text-password [parameter3]
set system login user client001 class su.command: set system login user client001 class super-user authentication plain-text-password password
set system login user client001 class su.explanation: 配置系统登录用户，包括用户名、用户类别和认证方式。

set system services ssh root-login deny.command: set system services ssh root-login deny
set system services ssh root-login deny.explanation: 配置SSH服务拒绝root用户登录。

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: 对root用户登录采取的操作，例如deny。

set system services ssh protocol-version.command: set system services ssh protocol-version v2
set system services ssh protocol-version.explanation: 配置SSH服务使用的协议版本。

set system console device vty line 0 4.template: set system console device vty line [parameter1] [parameter2]
set system console device vty line 0 4.command: set system console device vty line 0 4
set system console device vty line 0 4.explanation: 配置控制台设备的VTY线路范围。

set system console device vty line 0 4 l.template: set system console device vty line [parameter1] [parameter2] login [parameter3]
set system console device vty line 0 4 l.command: set system console device vty line 0 4 login local
set system console device vty line 0 4 l.explanation: 配置VTY线路的登录方式为本地认证。

set system console device vty line 0 4 p.template: set system console device vty line [parameter1] [parameter2] protocol [parameter3]
set system console device vty line 0 4 p.command: set system console device vty line 0 4 protocol ssh
set system console device vty line 0 4 p.explanation: 配置VTY线路使用的协议为SSH。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.1/32
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。
